change_description: Introduces strengthened organisational expectations around documented processing purposes, access controls and evidence supporting the handling of personal information.
Clarifies requirements for retention schedules, review of unnecessary personal data and secure disposal after applicable retention periods.
Strengthens expectations for documenting personal-data incidents, assessing risk and maintaining evidence supporting notification decisions.
Clarifies requirements for consistent and non-discriminatory employment practices across recruitment, promotion and workplace decisions.
Strengthens expectations for considering reasonable workplace adjustments and documenting decisions without unnecessary disclosure of sensitive information.
Introduces stronger expectations for evidence, complaint handling and retention of records supporting fair employment practices.
Strengthens requirements affecting financial records, reporting evidence and controls supporting accurate financial information.
Clarifies requirements for maintaining supporting tax records and ensuring timely, traceable reporting and payment processes.
Strengthens expectations for audit evidence, review trails and retention of records supporting financial compliance.
Introduces changes affecting the calculation, reporting and evidencing of employment income and payroll-related obligations.
Clarifies treatment and documentation requirements for employee benefits and compensation-related information used for tax purposes.
Strengthens expectations for maintaining payroll records and evidence supporting employment-income calculations and reporting.
Introduces changes affecting local planning, community participation and organisational engagement with local authorities and stakeholders.
Clarifies expectations relevant to local participation, procurement processes and evidence supporting local governance decisions.
Strengthens requirements for documenting local regulatory obligations, decisions, consultations and evidence of compliance.
